import sys

def solve():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    n, b = data[0], data[1]
    arr = data[2:]
    if n % 2 == 1:
        sys.stdout.write("0")
        return
    ec = 0
    oc = 0
    values = []
    for i in range(n):
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            ec += 1
        else:
            oc += 1
        if ec > 0 and oc > 0 and ec == oc:
            if i + 1 < n:
                values.append(abs(arr[i] - arr[i+1]))
    if not values:
        sys.stdout.write("0")
        return
    if len(values) == 1:
        if values[0] <= b:
            sys.stdout.write("1")
        else:
            sys.stdout.write("0")
        return
    values.sort()
    k = 0
    for v in values:
        if v <= b:
            b -= v
            k += 1
        else:
            break
    sys.stdout.write(str(k))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
